description: Designs an AI receptionist for a business from Holston AI's templates: the step-by-step call flow, what it does at any point (pricing questions, emergencies, transfers), and a link to holstonai.com where the owner can edit it and talk to the agent out loud in their browser for free. Only the industry and business name are required. Holston AI builds the real version on the business's phone line at a fixed price confirmed after a short call.

add_steps.description: Optional step ids to switch on, e.g. photos, returning, message.

business_name.description: The business name the agent answers with.

city.description: Main service area, if it is one of these East Tennessee and Southwest Virginia cities.

emergency_transfer.description: Transfer emergencies to an on-call number (default true where emergencies apply).

pricing.description: How the agent answers pricing questions.

services.description: Service ids from the template. Defaults to the template's main services.

name: design_ai_agent
title: AI Receptionist Designer
